# harborpilot_event_destination (Resource)

A Pulse or signed-webhook destination for domain events.

Changes made outside Terraform are detected on refresh and shown as a diff of `spec`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_event_destination" "webhook" {
  name = "audit-webhook"
  spec = jsonencode({
    type        = "webhook"
    webhook_url = "https://audit.example.com/hooks/harbor-pilot"
    filter      = { events = ["config.*", "access.*"] }
    enabled     = true
  })
  secrets_wo         = { signing_secret = var.webhook_signing_secret }
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name (lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`).
- `spec` (String) The event destination specification as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode({...})`. See the `DestinationSpec` schema in the Harbor Pilot API reference. Properties you leave out are sent as their zero value (empty string, list or map, `0`, `false`), except `enabled`, which must be set.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `secrets_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only secret values by name (`signing_secret`, `previous_signing_secret`, `creds`). Never stored in state or plan. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes. Prefer secret references in the spec.
- `secrets_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `secrets_wo` again (for example after rotating a secret).

### Read-Only

- `drift_state` (String) `drifted` when the object was changed outside Terraform since Terraform last wrote it.
- `id` (String) Stable object id.
- `managed_by` (String) Source of the last change (`terraform` after an apply).
- `revision` (Number) Server revision, used for optimistic concurrency.
- `secret_names` (Set of String) Names of the secrets currently set on the server (stored or referenced). Values are never returned.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id or by name.
terraform import harborpilot_event_destination.example <id-or-name>
```
